conclusions.beauty: C1 not stably better than same-capacity C0
conclusions.ml1m: A1 K3 C1 positive versus B0/C0 in both seeds; exploratory
conclusions.M1: Hard semantic segmentation not consistently superior to fixed C1; only ML K8 isolated benefit
conclusions.M2: Soft semantic read adds K parameters; no consistent independent gain across domains; inspect recorded tables
conclusions.BPR: Objective controls are not strict structure attribution across different losses
conclusions.missing: Six-seed confirmation, uncertainty/significance, chapter5 independent confirmation; no automatic training
conclusions.M2_detail: Both prior Test N5 below corresponding C1; Beauty raw improvement is mixed scoring evidence, not stable independent gain
